title: The unit ball of quadratic forms on an octagonal sector
summary: Let \[\mathfrak O=\{(x,y)\in[0,1]^2:x+y\le \sqrt2\} \] be the first-quadrant sector of a regular octagon. For quadratic forms \(P(x,y)=ax^2+bxy+cy^2\), we study the supremum norm over \(\mathfrak O\). We obtain a complete five-region formula for the norm, according to whether the norming contact occurs at an endpoint or in the interior of one of the three radial sides. We then prove that the projection of the unit ball onto the \(ac\)-plane is exactly \([-1,1]^2\), compute both endpoints of every vertical section, and thereby parametrize the entire unit sphere.
